overview: Cloud spend growing faster than revenue compresses the gross margin investors examine first, and GPU-heavy AI workloads have reopened a cost problem many engineering teams thought was settled. Finance and platform teams typically find out at month-end close, weeks after a runaway workload started burning budget. This engine ingests billing and usage exports, allocates spend to the products and teams that caused it, flags anomalies within a day, and ranks optimisation actions by saving against effort. Engineering decides whether a recommendation is applied; nothing is changed automatically. A four-to-five week build on the customer’s own billing data reveals actual tag coverage and where unit economics currently break down.
